data.description:
## Context / Problem
The gate's Pass-4 coaches authors via 15 registered moves (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/coach_moves.py), but src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md never names a single move — the guide is criterion-complete and move-blind, so an author coached "pin down X with a concrete worked example" has nowhere to look the technique up. Field frequency: specification-by-example 150 hits, plan-the-verification 96 (its observable-proxy rule absent from the guide), riskiest-assumption-test 51, state-attestation-evidence 41 (the [operator-attested] tag never appears), propagate-to-children 22.

## Approach
Add a "Responding to coaching moves" section to writing-a-passing-plan.md, keyed by move name in field-frequency order, with a one-paragraph technique description and a before/after example for each of the top five moves, plus a one-line index of the remaining registered moves. Cross-link the existing advisory section to it. Content stays in the hand-written guide (the criteria guide is generated; moves are not criteria). Alternative rejected: a generated per-move reference (rebar explain <move>) — larger machinery for content that fits one guide section; revisit if the section outgrows the guide.

## Scope
src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md, tests/test_guides.py (text assertions).

## Testing
Text assertions: the section exists; each of the five move names appears with an example block; the [operator-attested] tag appears in the state-attestation-evidence entry; every name matches the coach_moves.py registry spelling.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The guide contains a "Responding to coaching moves" section naming the top five moves in frequency order, each with an example (checked: unit test asserting section and move names).
- [ ] The [operator-attested] AC tag is documented in the guide (checked: text assertion).
- [ ] Move names match the MOVE_REGISTRY spellings exactly (checked: unit test importing coach_moves).
data.title: Add coaching moves to the plan-writing guide
